milestones.name: Mantis Lords Defeated
milestones.note: Mantises become neutral after defeat; unlocks Mark of Pride chest and connection to Deepnest

milestones.name: Mantis Claw Acquired
milestones.note: Found in west part of Mantis Village

milestones.name: Mark of Pride Acquired
milestones.note: Found in chest in southeast of Mantis Village after Mantis Lords are defeated

milestones.name: Zote Saved in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight rescues Zote from Vengefly King; Zote later appears in Dirtmouth

milestones.name: Zote Saved in Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight rescues Zote from spider webs in Deepnest

milestones.name: Zote Defeated at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Grants Rivalry achievement; Zote deals no damage due to shellwood nail

milestones.name: Love Key Acquired
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; opens door inside Tower of Love

milestones.name: Neglect Achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell in Greenpath if he was not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Home of the Mantis Tribe; buildings made of sinew and bone; heads of beasts on poles at border; western area contains Mantis Claw, southeast chest with Mark of Pride

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Mantis Village after Mantis Lords are defeated; contains spider webs where Zote is trapped

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Path where Zote is found trapped in mandibles of a Vengefly King

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote appears here if saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Corridor with storerooms where Zote is found after Greenpath encounter

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Resting area where Zote is captured and becomes final boss of first trial

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains locked door opened by Love Key; The Collector can be fought inside

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Found in west part of Mantis Village; if not acquired before a certain point, Zote dies in Greenpath

abilities.name: Mark of Pride
abilities.note: Found in chest in southeast of Mantis Village after Mantis Lords are defeated

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Opens door inside Tower of Love where the Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Defeating them makes all mantises neutral, unlocks Mark of Pride chest, and opens connection to Deepnest

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save or abandon Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; defeating grants Rivalry achievement

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Fought inside Tower of Love after opening door with Love Key
